name: Strategic Workforce Design & Resource Optimization
description: Deterministic operating framework to design the optimal execution model for an organization—evaluating the combination of human talent, AI agents, workflow automation, contractors, and token economics.
frameworks: Resource Optimization Matrix (Human vs AI vs Automation vs Contractor vs Hybrid)
logic: Designing an organization is not simply about hiring people. Modern execution models integrate human employees, leadership, AI agents, workflow automation, and external contractors. Design how work is accomplished before determining who or what should perform it.
chainsOfThought: Step 1: Initiate Workforce Planning -> Define Scope & Objectives -> Load Organizational Memory -> Identify Key Stakeholders
Step 2: Discover Organizational Context -> Analyze Business Model, Strategy & Technology Stack -> Map Business Priorities
Step 3: Strategic Work Design -> Map Capabilities, Workflows, Decision Complexity & Knowledge Dependencies -> Identify Repetitive vs High-Value Work
Step 4: Capability & Gap Analysis -> Assess Current Skills, Capacity & Leadership -> Identify Critical Skill Shortages
Step 5: Resource Optimization Analysis -> Evaluate Execution Models (Human, AI Agent, Automation, Contractor, Hybrid) -> Calculate Token & TCO Economics
Step 6: Design Future Workforce & AI Architecture -> Structure Teams, Roles, AI Agent Orchestration & Automation Pipelines
Step 7: Workforce Economics & Financial Integration -> Model Labor Costs, AI Subscriptions, Token Consumption & Total Cost of Ownership
Step 8: Human Review & Approval -> Broadcast WebSocket Approval Request via ExecApprovalManager -> Obtain Leadership Authorization
Step 9: Execute Workforce Strategy -> Launch Hiring, AI Deployment & Workflow Automations
Step 10: Monitor Workforce Intelligence -> Track Token Usage, API Costs, Hiring Velocity, Productivity & System Health
Step 11: Learn & Update Organizational Memory -> Archive Lessons Learned & Refine Execution Models
bestPractices: Design work before designing jobs; eliminate unnecessary work before staffing or automating it.
Select the smallest AI model that reliably meets quality requirements to optimize token TCO.
Require explicit human executive sign-off before authorizing hiring, organizational restructuring, or major AI deployments.
